utility.notes: Lodi Electric Utility is the City of Lodi's own municipal electric utility, distinct from PG&E. The city's own materials confirm 'solar/battery interconnection goes through LEU not PG&E' and that all residential solar installations require LEU pre-approval before a City building permit can be obtained.

value.name: Lodi Electric Utility (LEU)
value.notes: LEU is a vertically-integrated municipal utility — it generates/procures and delivers its own power rather than sitting alongside a separate CCA, consistent with the pattern already established for MID, TID, SMUD, and Roseville Electric this session.

permit_authority.value: City of Lodi Community Development Department, Building and Safety Inspection Division

interconnection_url.notes: Lodi Electric Utility's own interconnection rule (Rule No. 21), identified via search-engine indexing; not independently fetched this session.

battery_programs.notes: The statewide SGIP program (administered by the CPUC-regulated IOUs) does not apply to LEU customers, since LEU is a municipal utility outside CPUC jurisdiction, consistent with other municipal-utility records this session.

value.name: Last 12 months of utility bill usage history (used to determine maximum allowable system size)
Written estimates from at least three solar contractors
System plans and proposed system size, submitted by the contractor to LEU for pre-approval

value: Contractor completes installation, then schedules final inspection with the City of Lodi Building Department
Upon passing inspection, a solar meter is installed within 10 business days
After meter installation, authorization to energize the system is issued, and a Permission to Operate (PTO) certificate is generated

value.notes: LEU's pre-approval review (required before a building permit can be obtained) can take up to two weeks; after passing final inspection, solar meter installation occurs within 10 business days.

value.program_or_pathway: LEU pre-approval + City building/electrical permit (also SolarAPP+ available)
other_conditions: Maximum allowable system size is determined by the customer's last 12 months of energy usage history
LEU pre-approval is required before a City of Lodi building permit can be obtained
